settings.name: Doran Precision Engineering Ltd
settings.address: 84B Dundrum Road Industrial Estate, Newcastle, Northern Ireland, BT33 0LN
settings.about: Doran Precision Engineering is a family-founded business based in Newcastle, County Down. It manufactures precision components for aerospace, medical and motorsport applications, with batch production, rapid response and rework services. The company’s published history dates its founding to 1993.

services.title: CNC Machining
services.short: Precision components shaped to your requirements.
services.body: Doran Precision Engineering manufactures precision components using CNC machining. Its published capabilities include 5-axis machining for small batches and prototypes. Send your drawings and application requirements to discuss a suitable manufacturing approach.

services.title: Batch Production
services.short: Manufacturing support for repeat component requirements.
services.body: The company’s published service offer includes batch production for precision components. Discuss drawings, materials, quantities and delivery requirements with the team.

services.title: Rapid Response & Rework
services.body: Doran lists rapid response and rework among its services. Contact the team with the part requirements and requested timescale so feasibility and availability can be assessed.

services.title: Inspection
services.short: Measurement and reporting for manufactured components.
services.body: The published capabilities include 3D measurement using a FARO Gage measuring arm and tailored inspection reports for first article inspection. Confirm the reporting requirements for your project with the team.

services.title: After Production Services
services.body: Doran lists a range of finishing solutions coordinated through third parties, including powder coating, plating, chemical film, anodising and passivation. Wire insert fitment is also listed. Discuss the finish and documentation needed for your components.

services.title: Materials
services.short: Discuss the material your component requires.
services.body: Published machining materials include aluminium grades 6082, 6061, 7075 and 2024, stainless steel, nylon, Delrin and black acetal. Confirm the required grade and current capability with the team before placing an order.
